Read `docs/audit/fixer-rules.md` and follow its Rules. `{{DIGESTS}}` holds one previous-version digest per artifact, of this checkout against `HEAD`: the rubric repairs in `{{REPAIRS_PATCH}}` and the fixer's edits. For every `para:` and `file:` line in it whose id has no row in `docs/audit/recovery/<name>/record.md`, add one row in that file's Recovery record format, with `item` the id copied exactly as the digest prints it. An item that a hunk of `{{REPAIRS_PATCH}}` removed or rewrote gets fate `removed-on-merit`, value `real` or `low` by the fixer rules, decision `intended-change`, reason class `fact-update`, reason `rubric repair for the Agent Skills spec change (<date>)`, whether or not the skill is in the targets. Any other item gets the row the fixer rules give it. Edit no file other than those records; they are part of the change, not audit artifacts.
